user_supplied_game_observation.observation: The same single Infantry does not lose attack power as it is worn down.

exposure: Inputs were read with outcomes redacted. General attrition predictions were stated before inspection. Inventory work may previously have exposed some endpoints, so the exercise is retrospective corroboration, not a newly blinded game trial. No inner attack-count alternative is tested: the user reports that a worn single Infantry retains its attack power, positively supporting the existing inner ceil.
score_note: Signed score is0 for simulator draws and is not the remaining attacker count in a both-alive battle. Selected examples are attacker wins, so signed score equals attacker survivors. Survival counts remain valid for all16 rows.
